title: Bean home · 2D reference board
scope: A private visual study for Hamlet. All rendered room artwork is original SVG; these references inform composition and interaction language only.

sources.name: Unpacking · Witch Beam
sources.use: Readable domestic cutaways, object-scale storytelling, and the calm satisfaction of a thing belonging somewhere.

sources.name: A Little to the Left · Max Inferno
sources.use: Tactile household objects and small, intuitive cause-and-effect without a heavy interface.

sources.name: Spiritfarer · Thunder Lotus
sources.use: Warm hand-crafted materials, generous negative space, and a home that supports care rather than pressure.

translation: Cutaway room: one large structural silhouette frames distinct, legible activity zones.
Function becomes furniture: letters in a tray, notes on a pinboard, lessons at a desk, ideas at a workbench.
Cream walls, deep forest shadows, rust accents and honey wood form a low-contrast, afternoon palette.
Bean stays small against furniture, so a walk across the rug feels like a real journey through its home.
Feedback is physical and local: an envelope lifts, a pin note flutters, a notebook opens, a bulb warms.
